title: Authorized-Representative Forms Accepted per Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Payer Class
content:
A member-level appeal of a Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) needs the patient's signed authorized-representative form, of the kind the payer class accepts. This schedule names that form and how long a signature stays usable.

| Payer class | Form the payer class accepts | Signed form required for a member-level appeal | Valid for (calendar days from the patient's signature date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | plan authorized-representative form | yes | 365 |
| Commercial HMO Claim | plan authorized-representative form | yes | 365 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | plan authorized-representative form | yes | 365 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | CMS-1696 appointment of representative form | yes | 365 |
| Original Medicare Claim | CMS-1696 appointment of representative form | yes | 365 |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | state Medicaid authorized-representative form | yes | 365 |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | plan authorized-representative form | yes | 365 |

**Signature channels (every payer class):** the patient may sign through the patient portal by electronic signature, by a mailed wet signature, or in person.

Example (hypothetical): a CMS-1696 form signed 365 days before a filing date is still within its validity; one signed 366 days before is not.
